semantics.clock: All sequential changes occur on the positive edge of clk.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset has priority in every phase; after its rising edge all outputs are zero and pattern search starts with no history. No power-up initialization is specified.
semantics.search: Sample data on each rising edge while searching for contiguous 1101. Preserve the longest matching suffix on mismatches, so 11101 and 1101101 detect correctly when searching.
semantics.shift: The rising edge sampling the final pattern 1 enters shift phase, asserting shift_ena immediately afterward. It stays high for four complete clock periods; four subsequent rising edges correspond to the four additional bits. After the fourth edge shift_ena falls and counting rises.
semantics.count: Hold counting until a rising edge with done_counting high while already counting; then counting falls and done rises. done_counting is ignored during search and shifting.
semantics.notify: Hold done until a rising edge with ack high while already in notification; then return to empty search. ack is ignored in other phases, including the edge first entering notification. Data on the acknowledgement edge is not part of the next pattern.
semantics.outputs: Moore outputs, mutually exclusive; all zero in search. data is ignored during shifting, counting and notification by this control-only FSM.

numeric.ports: All ports are unsigned single-bit control signals.
numeric.datapath: No duration storage, arithmetic, counters, saturation or rounding is required. Four shift cycles are encoded as four distinct states.
numeric.state: Ten states fit in four bits; unused encodings recover to empty search.

verification.oracle: Independent behavioral model with a rolling four-bit search history and a phase-local remaining shift-cycle count, comparing all outputs after every rising edge.
verification.directed: Exercise 1101, repeated ones, failed prefixes, all 256 eight-bit search streams, exactly four shifts, early done_counting/ack, held done, acknowledgement and repeated transactions.
verification.reset: Reset in search and each active phase; check synchronous behavior between edges and priority at edges.
verification.random: Deterministic pseudorandom input controls and occasional reset, with cycle-by-cycle oracle comparison.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts; no synthesis or official evaluation.

specification_ambiguities: Overlap handling is not explicitly stated; searching for an occurrence of contiguous 1101 is interpreted as retaining valid suffix prefixes.
Cycle boundaries are interpreted as a Moore FSM: done_counting and ack are consumed only in their respective active phases.
